response: ["When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions and on the genitalia.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor, and in the same operative setting, whenever possible.","The 5-point score is driven by pigment_network (atypical, 2 points).","The 5-point score is driven by pigmentation (diffuse irregular, 1 point).","The 5-point score is driven by dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point).","The 5-point score is driven by regression_structures (white areas, 1 point).","These features are minor or major features associated with melanoma.","On the image, verify the presence and morphology of an atypical pigment network (irregular meshes and thickened lines).","On the image, verify the presence and morphology of white scar-like regression structures."]
